notes: Gear skills: fitted rune words and enchantment scrolls each grant ONE extra skill while the gear is worn (12_Systems/gear_and_runes.md, 05_Skills_Magic/rune_and_enchant_skills.md). Nothing here breaks, wears out or gambles. A gear skill is small by design: its total hit power stays under every class ultimate and its cost, cooldown and level gate keep it a side option, never a replacement for the class kit. Power scales with the fitting's quality statMult (weakest rune for a word). Decided 2026-11-08 by Claude under delegated creative control; the user may overrule. ENGINE GAP: Ascend.Core does not yet grant skills from fittings and Unity combat does not read this file (flagged to core-rules-engineer and gameplay-engineer).

skills.name: Oathstrike
skills.effect: Two-beat strike sworn on the anvil; the heavy second hit breaks a guard.

skills.name: Stonewatch Stance
skills.effect: Plant your feet: damage taken -15% and no stagger for 6s. You cannot dash while it lasts.

skills.name: Stormfast Step
skills.effect: A gust-borne dash that clips anything in the path.

skills.name: Hearthfire Ring
skills.effect: A ring of hearth-light: scorches foes inside it, and allies standing in it regain 4% max HP over 5s.

skills.name: Emberbrand Slash
skills.effect: The brand flares along the blade for one burning cut.

skills.name: Stormthread Lance
skills.effect: Lets the woven thread loose as a lance of lightning.

skills.name: Ward Pulse
skills.effect: The weave pulses outward: a shield worth 8% max HP for 5s.

skills.name: Second Wind
skills.effect: Draw one steady breath: regain 8% max HP over 4s.

skills.name: Nightstep Slip
skills.effect: A silent slip-step; your next hit within 3s has +5% crit chance.
